note: Mapillary comparison of the 304 survey viewpoints. coverage is photo or no coverage. Photos CC BY-SA, looked at only. heading_diff_deg is null for panoramas. Findings carry the survey layer, severity, tag mly (checked against Mapillary) and being_worked_on for areas other agents are changing.

mem_recheck.note: Photo (2018) shows stone pines, bare planes and a palm along the palace bastion, so spruce cones and lime lawn are wrong; the stone piazza with palms and magnolias is not in the photo (cannot tell).
No Mapillary coverage on the ZEN and Tommaso Natale viewpoints.
Real Via Rosario Nicoletti meets asphalt with a plain kerb and a narrow ledge or wall; there is no sand band, the tan edge band is a game artefact.
Spruce cones are the wrong species wherever photos exist (broadleaf, stone pine, olive); the ZEN fringe itself has no coverage.
Via Tolomea has no photo; mo12 (Viale Venere) shows the same garden-wall streets under tree canopy that the game lacks, which is consistent but not the same street.
None of the Mapillary photos shows bunting; the game hangs it on street corners in many views.
No photo of the pier; the game shows the beach cabin rows, which also exist in reality.

Main Mondello roads (Viale dell Olimpo, Regina Elena, Rosario Nicoletti) have 8 to 10 m arm lamps like the game; only villa lanes use 5 to 6 m ornamental lamps (mo09), so the finding holds for side streets only.
Real roadsides are dark hedges, oleander, agave, pines and dry verge; none has a mown lime lawn.
No Mapillary coverage of Viale Strasburgo at these viewpoints.

The game is wrong, but not for the stated reason: Via Vergine Maria and Via Papa Sergio I are lined by long masonry garden walls, cypress and parked cars, not by 3 to 5 storey buildings with pavements.

The Politeama theatre IS in view in the game at po02 (small cream block at the end of the plaza). The Mapillary photo looks along another street, so the photo cannot confirm the shape of the arch and quadriga; the verdict is from the game shot.
Real Via della Liberta has plane rows on both sides and service roads; game hedges are tall flat-topped cuboids (1.5 m) where the real ones are 0.8 m clipped strips.
The photo looks away from the stadium; it confirms a plaster park wall and stone pines along Viale del Fante, not lawn and spruce.
No coverage at La Zisa or Palazzina Cinese.

Real medians are a guard-railed or iron-railed strip (with the tram line on Via Castellana), not bare dirt; the survey guess of an oleander row is not what the photos show (iron railing and catenary poles instead).
No coverage.
No coverage.
Real slope is terraced olive scrub and walled lanes under a steep limestone face; the game has a smooth beige mound. Mandarin orchards themselves are not visible in the photos.

Street-level photos show grey limestone cliffs, dry grass tufts and scrub, with pine only in patches; the game mountain is greener and the cliff faces are forest-dotted. Aerial colour itself is not checkable.
No stadium photos.

viewpoints.name: Quattro Canti, Via Maqueda north
viewpoints.verdict: Mapillary frame is from the open Quattro Canti crossing 23 m away (Apr 2022); its compass_angle is 0 (unreliable), the view really looks south down Via Maqueda. The game viewpoint was snapped into a 4 m alley.

findings.text: Quattro Canti is unrecognisable at the viewpoint: real view is the open octagon with two huge baroque corner facades (statues in niches, paired columns, fountains, ornate lamp), game is a blank 4 m ashlar canyon.
The ce01 to ce03 snap point is an alley, not the crossing. Verdict on survey finding 7 below.

game_shot_at_photo_position.verdict: Game camera moved to the Mapillary position (16 m north of the viewpoint), looking south.

findings.text: At the crossing itself the game still shows no octagon: a blank buff wall with a red awning at right and a straight street ahead, instead of the two concave baroque corner facades with statues and fountains that dominate the real photo.

viewpoints.name: Quattro Canti, Corso Vittorio Emanuele west

findings.text: Same as ce01.

viewpoints.name: Quattro Canti, Corso Vittorio Emanuele east
viewpoints.verdict: Mapillary frame points at the tarmac (camera tilted down), nothing to compare. Game view shows an arched wall and a blank alley, no octagon.

viewpoints.name: Via Maqueda south of Quattro Canti
viewpoints.verdict: Via Maqueda south of the crossing, 1 m, Aug 2021.

findings.text: Real street is an asphalt road with a white edge line and dashed lane marks, narrow stone pavements, bollards and planters, and open cafe tables; game paves the whole width with stone slabs (a pedestrian plaza) and draws two pothole decals on slabs.
Real street has cafe umbrellas, chairs and tables on the kerb, a no-entry sign, litter bins, a gate and graffiti; the game has none of these.
Real left building is a pale 5 storey with iron balconies and shuttered graffiti-covered ground floors; game left wall is a blank buff slab with a few windows.

viewpoints.name: Via Maqueda north toward Teatro Massimo

findings.text: Real: asphalt road with dashed centre line and stone kerbs, pedestrians walking in the road; game: whole street is stone slab paving.
Real: high tables and stools, A-frame menu boards, parasols, potted plants, big carved wooden portal on the right. Game has a single parasol and dark roller shutters under red-gold fascias.
Real left is cream plaster with arched windows; game left is a tall 8 storey buff tower with no balconies.

viewpoints.name: Piazza Pretoria
viewpoints.verdict: The photo is taken from a church roof terrace (dome and cranes in view), not from the street; the game stands in a lane at Piazza Pretoria. Not comparable. Note: the skyline backdrop of mountains is present in both.

findings.text: Game shows the palazzo with a clock tower at the end of the lane, which cannot be checked against this photo.

viewpoints.name: Piazza Bellini / Martorana
viewpoints.verdict: Photo is 46 m away on a street with a similar heading (Corso Vittorio Emanuele side street), Aug 2021. The game viewpoint is a 3 m alley.

findings.text: Real street is a 9 m asphalt road with a white centre line, shop terraces and pedestrians; game shows a 3 m stone-slab alley with a tan mid-width. See ce09_p for the shot at the photo position.
Real facades are 5 storey with deep iron balconies, plants, arched shopfronts and postcard stands; game walls are flat buff with a few balconies and a single dark arch.
Bicycles, A-frame boards, postcard racks, benches, festoon lights missing.

game_shot_at_photo_position.verdict: Game camera at the photo position (46 m along the street).

findings.text: The game ground here is a tan terrain-tint plain instead of an asphalt road with a centre line, and the facades are set back from it: the street surface layer is missing.
Real street is a continuous 5 storey wall with arched shopfronts and balconies; game has an isolated 4 storey block and a gap.

viewpoints.name: Corso Vittorio Emanuele at Cattedrale
viewpoints.verdict: Photo is the cathedral south front from the forecourt, 30 m away, Apr 2022; heading differs by 32 degrees.

findings.text: Game cathedral side is a flat buff wall with pointed lancet windows and a battlement; the real one is a many-layered Arab-Norman front with interlaced arch bands, a tall clock tower with a pyramid spire, a ribbed white dome and a flanking Gothic porch.
Real forecourt has palms, clipped globe shrubs and a hedge parterre; game has blocky plinths and white boxes (statue bases without statues).
Statue plinths are blank cuboids, real balustrade carries marble statues.

game_shot_at_photo_position.verdict: Game camera at the photo position, looking at the cathedral's south front.

findings.text: Cathedral is present with the right overall layout (battlemented wall, a square tower at the left), which is better than the survey feared, but it lacks the ribbed white dome, the tower clock and spire, and the interlaced-arch bands; the wall has plain pointed lancets. Recognisable only to someone who knows the building.
Forecourt has bare slabs and a lawn patch; real has palms, clipped shrubs and a flower parterre.

viewpoints.name: Corso Vittorio Emanuele at Porta Nuova
Piazza Indipendenza, Palazzo dei Normanni
viewpoints.verdict: 17 m away, Feb 2018, winter, windscreen photo looking along the Palazzo dei Normanni bastion, 43 degrees off heading.

findings.text: Real roadside has stone pines, bare planes and a palm; game has lime lawn with spruce cones and fat ball trees.
The long bastion wall of the palace on the right (grey-ochre, 8 m high, sloping base) is missing; the game shows open lawn and an apartment slab beyond.
Real road is a 2 lane street with a dashed line, kerbs and a bus stop; game has a smudged zebra crossing, black skid pairs and pothole decals.
City bus, bus stop pole, slim curved lamp posts missing.

game_shot_at_photo_position.verdict: Game camera at the photo position.

findings.text: The 8 m high palace bastion wall along the right of the road is absent; the game shows open lawn with spruce cones and ball trees.
Spruce cones at the horizon instead of stone pines, bare planes and a palm.
Road is flanked by pale paving and a tan dirt strip; skid pairs across the lane.

viewpoints.name: Corso Re Ruggero
viewpoints.verdict: Corso Re Ruggero, 2 m, Apr 2021, 44 degrees off; the photo is a close-up of a gate pier and a glass bus shelter, with a 5 storey cream block across the road.

findings.text: Real far block is cream with small balconies and shopfronts; game blocks are ochre with dark window grids (colour and rhythm are close enough, bunting at upper right of the game shot is out of place).
Real road is a narrow curve with kerbs; game is 14 m of asphalt with a 10 m pale pavement either side.

viewpoints.name: Via Guglielmo il Buono
viewpoints.verdict: Via Guglielmo il Buono, 15 m, Feb 2015.

findings.text: Real left side is a tall dressed-stone retaining wall under big ficus and holm oak; game has a bare 5 storey ochre slab with garage shutters at the foot and no trees.
The retaining wall is replaced by building massing; the upper palazzo set back behind the wall is missing.
Real road has a yellow-black bollard median on the right with kerb, solid edge lines and two lanes; game road is a flat strip with no markings except a pale kerb.

viewpoints.name: Via Porta di Castro
viewpoints.verdict: Via Porta di Castro, 6 m, Aug 2021.

findings.text: Real lane is an old-town alley: arched wooden doors, wrought-iron balcony canopies, cream and ochre plaster, awnings, plants on the street; game is a 4 m canyon with one blank buff wall (left) and shuttered shopfronts (right).
Parked Pandas and a delivery van, potted plants, a folding stall at the kerb: none present.
Game adds a raised pale pavement on one side; real has none.

Real alley is a 4 m canyon of weathered terracotta and ochre plaster with a dark painted skirt, a baroque dome at the end, carved balcony brackets, scooters and cars parked tight; game has two tall flat ashlar blocks with small black windows.
Parked cars, scooters, a manhole cover, patched surface; game has a light-blue box car dead centre and cardboard stacks, and a raised pale pavement the real alley does not have.

Real street walls are 5 storey baroque palazzi with deep wrought-iron balconies on carved stone brackets, weathered brown plaster and arched doors; game has smooth buff blocks with small windows plus a 7 storey modern slab on the right.
Real road has painted arrows, a bus bay, parked cars and kerbs; game has a zebra crossing drawn over pits and a puddle decal.
Terracotta pots with agave on the pavement, wall-mounted lanterns: absent.

viewpoints.name: Via Vittorio Emanuele at Porta Felice
viewpoints.verdict: Via Vittorio Emanuele towards the Cala, 16 m, May 2021.

findings.text: Real view ends at the marina with masts and a Phoenix palm group at the quay; game shows trees and a yellow bus at a plaza and no masts.
Real left is a pale institutional block with tall arched windows; game left is dark brown with garage doors, close in height but wrong colour.
Real has a bollard kerb on the left, parked cars along the quay, a no-parking sign; game has none.

viewpoints.name: Via Maqueda / Via Roma near Stazione
viewpoints.verdict: Via Maqueda near the station, 1 m, Sept 2021.

findings.text: Real street is asphalt with a white edge line, a stone kerb and terracotta planters; game paves the whole width with stone slabs and shows people walking in it. The pedestrian-plaza reading is wrong for Via Maqueda south of the crossing.
Large cream parasols, boxed trees in terracotta planters, outdoor tables and a bench with seated people are missing from the game, which does have a small awning and parasol far away.
Facade massing and balcony brackets are close, and the game left building is a good match; SUCA wall tag on the right facade is being worked on.

viewpoints.name: Corso Vittorio Emanuele, Piazza della Vittoria
Via Torquato Tasso
viewpoints.verdict: Via Torquato Tasso / Via Crispi junction, 19 m, Apr 2017 (blur).

findings.text: Game has a big tan sand patch on the left of the carriageway and a long skid rectangle; real has kerbs, pavements and stone pines at the roadside.
Real street is full of moving and parked cars and shop awnings with stalls at the kerb; game has an empty road with a bus at the far end.
Stone pines and a hedge strip (left of the real photo) missing; game has one round tree on the right.
Real right side is a concrete block with an arcaded ground floor and shops; game right side is a tall buff building with a tiered edge and no arcade.

viewpoints.name: Via Maqueda at Via Cavour, north end
Via Abramo Lincoln
viewpoints.verdict: Via Abramo Lincoln, 2 m, May 2021; a game bus blocks half the view.

findings.text: Real street has a blooming jacaranda and rows of cars parked under it; game has none near the camera.
Real left is a white neoclassical palazzo with iron balconies; right is low shuttered warehouses. Game right shows a long 4 storey arcaded palazzo, which is the wrong building type on that side.
Rows of parked cars on the left kerb missing.

viewpoints.name: Via Venti Settembre
viewpoints.verdict: Via Venti Settembre / Via Vittorio Emanuele, 43 m, May 2021; the photo looks at a wide junction with a hoarded building site and a large cream palazzo behind palms.

findings.text: Real view opens onto a wide junction with a big neoclassical palazzo and palms; game stays in a closed 8 m canyon of buff and brown blocks with roller shutters and no sight line to the palazzo.
Orange mesh site hoarding, a billboard, a column of parked and queued cars, palms: none in the game.
Game road has a broad crack decal and a puddle; real is clean asphalt.

game_shot_at_photo_position.verdict: Game camera at the photo position.

findings.text: The cream palazzo at the end of the street is present as a buff block with the right massing, and the junction width is close; the game has an arched church-like block and a bus in the lane.
Hoarding, billboard, car queue missing; palms replaced by ball trees.

viewpoints.name: Piazza Ruggero Settimo, Politeama
viewpoints.verdict: Via near Piazza Ruggero Settimo, 21 m, June 2014 (early morning).

findings.text: Real street has cars parked on both kerbs, bikes, dustbins and a yellow edge line; game has an empty road with a dumpster in the foreground and a dark slab decal.
Real facades are saturated yellow and orange plaster, 5 storey with deep stepped balconies, shop fronts with steel shutters, AC units and satellite dishes; game facades are dull buff with louvres.
Game has 6 m pale pavements either side of an 11 m road; real has 1.5 m pavements.

viewpoints.name: Piazza Castelnuovo
viewpoints.verdict: Piazza Castelnuovo, 22 m, June 2014; the photo is taken in the avenue beside the piazza (planes, parked cars), the game camera stands in the paved plaza.

findings.text: Real avenue is a continuous canopy of plane and jacaranda trees along both sides of Via Ruggero Settimo; game has ball trees and a large paved plaza with a grey slab floor.
Row of parked cars and motorbike parking on the left kerb, no-parking sign, café parasols missing; game has pedestrians standing in a tinted slab plaza.

The Politeama is visible in the game at the far end as a cream block with a stepped pediment, so survey finding 1 (not in view) does not hold at this spot; it is a few pixels wide and the colonnade arch and quadriga are not distinguishable.

viewpoints.name: Via Francesco Crispi at Piazza Politeama
Via della Liberta @57%
viewpoints.verdict: Via della Liberta west side, 4 m, Sept 2021, dusk.

findings.text: Real left side is a tall dark-green iron railing on a stone plinth along a garden, with leaves behind it, plus a long row of parked cars; game has cube hedges (flat-topped boxes) and big dome trees.
Real trees are slim planes with irregular crowns; game trees are huge flat-shaded domes with straight brown trunks and no understory.
Hexagon-pattern pavement, ornate black lamp on the corner, parked cars: lamp missing, car row replaced by a single white car.

viewpoints.name: Via della Liberta @76%
viewpoints.verdict: Via della Liberta service road, 12 m, Feb 2015 (sun flare, 31 degrees off).

findings.text: Real right side is a black iron railing on a low plinth in front of a 7 storey 1960s block with shop signs; game has cube hedges and open pavement.
Real trees are sparse bare-trunked planes; game has a dense tunnel of dark domes.
Real has a kerbed median and a parking lane; game has two white dashed lines on an empty road.

viewpoints.name: Via della Liberta @94%
viewpoints.verdict: Via della Liberta, 2 m, June 2014. This is the best match in Politeama: boulevard layout, tree rows, hedges and palazzi all read.

findings.text: Real planes are tall with open, light-green crowns and trunks that lean; game trees are dark, heavy low-poly domes on straight brown trunks.
Real hedges are clipped 0.8 m strips along the kerb; game hedges are 1.5 m cuboids.
Real road has a thick yellow median stripe, a double white line and a bus lane; game has two thin white dashed lines. Palms (left) and purple jacaranda in the distance missing.
Real right side is a continuous construction hoarding with concrete barriers and billboards; game has a tan sand plain stretching to the horizon with ball trees.
Billboards, a truck, hoarding, curved lamp posts missing; game has a box car in the foreground.
Monte Pellegrino silhouette appears in both, the game one is pale.

viewpoints.name: Francesco Crispi @85%
viewpoints.verdict: Via Francesco Crispi south, 1 m, Apr 2022.

findings.text: Real road is a narrow one-way service lane (about 6 m) with parked cars along the kerb, running beside a sunken carriageway behind a concrete wall and railings; game has a wide open junction with 20 m of pale and sand-tinted apron and scattered cars.
Real right block is a white modern 9 storey with glass balcony parapets and shopfronts; game right block is a ribbed buff slab with dark louvre windows.
Cars parked bumper to bumper missing; the real curved lamp and tall pole are replaced by stray dumpsters.
Real street is lined with cars on both kerbs, motorbikes and a speed-limit sign; game has a yellow bus filling the right half and no parked cars.
Flowering jacaranda and a palm at the junction ahead missing.
Game has a tan band and pale apron to the left of the road; real has a kerb and a car row.
The 10 to 12 storey balconied blocks on both sides match real heights well, which is the best part of this view; game tint is browner and balconies are flat.
Real has parked cars along both sides in a continuous row, an ESSO station with a red canopy and a price pylon, a scaffolded building and bare trees; game has a red box car and an empty road.
The ESSO station is a local landmark of this junction and is missing.
Game right side is a 3 storey garage block with balconies; real right is a 7 storey block next to the station. Distant towers are fine.
Real street has an iron-railed tram median with overhead wires, queued cars, and a hedge and tree row behind the railing; game has an open junction with a huge pale plaza bite and one white van.
Rounded evergreen trees (laurel and ficus) behind the railing missing.
Game apron is 15 m of pale slab; real road meets a railing and kerb.

Real left side is a black iron railing on a concrete plinth guarding the tram line, with overhead catenary on red poles; the right has bus-stop boards, a stone pine and kiosks. Game has none of these (tram line missing) and a floating box car plus dumpsters.
Real blocks are orange, yellow and cream with deep balconies and awnings; game blocks are uniform buff with a regular balcony ledge band.
Street width and 8 to 9 storey block heights are a good match.
Real has an Osteria sign, an Italian flag on the palazzo, shop fronts at street level, scooters and cars at the kerbs; game has a white car in the foreground and a pedestrian only.
Colour and balcony rhythm of the game blocks are close to real (the real left block is white with long balconies, game left block is orange-brown).
Street width and 8 storey height are a good match; this is one of the closer Politeama views.

viewpoints.name: Via Belgio @50%
viewpoints.verdict: Via Belgio ring road, 4 m, Apr 2024, overcast.

findings.text: Real road is a motorway-grade carriageway with double steel guard rails on both sides, a hatched gore, green exit signs and tall lamp masts; game has a 2 lane road with a dashed centre line and sand bands 15 m wide either side.
Sand bands read as bare earth; real has a rail and scrub verge only 1 to 2 m wide.
Mid-rise blocks on the horizon exist in both.

viewpoints.name: Via dei Nebrodi @50%
viewpoints.verdict: Via dei Nebrodi, 23 m, Apr 2017, 31 degrees off.

findings.text: Real left is a median planted with large ficus and broadleaf trees, right side has parked cars under tree canopy; game has no trees and a huge pale plaza on both sides.
Cars parked bumper to bumper on the right kerb, a cafe terrace with awning: missing.
Game left block is a uniform 6 storey slab with identical balconies for 150 m; real blocks are mixed cream and white with different heights.
Skid-mark pairs and a black 3 m hexagon in the game road are far worse than the real surface.
Real avenue has big plane trees overhanging both kerbs, a palm and a stone-pine row; game has bare pale paving and one lawn strip on the right.
Cars parked on the right kerb with blue-line bays, traffic lights on mast arms, a road sign: missing.
Game pavement apron is 12 m wide on each side; real has 2 m pavements with trees.
Real left block is white with long balconies, right block cream; game blocks are buff and brown with louvres.

viewpoints.name: Piazza Antonino Caponnetto @50%
viewpoints.verdict: Piazza Antonino Caponnetto, 7 m, Apr 2022, 9 degrees off, strong sun flare.

findings.text: Real right side is a 5 m transparent and black noise barrier on a raised ramp with a guard rail and a 40 km/h sign; game has a plain ashlar-textured retaining wall.
Real horizon has port gantry cranes and a container yard; game has a small tan shop and ball trees.
Game has a tan sand band left and a pale apron right of the road; real has a kerb and guard rail.
Game has a long black crack line across the lane.

Real left side is a continuous plastered garden wall with villas, palms and parked cars behind it; right side is a raised kerb with a dense strip of oleander, agave and stone pines. Game has a wide pale promenade on both sides, widely spaced palms and open lawn with no walls or hedges.
Real trees are stone pines, date palms with full crowns and oleander; game palms have 12 m bare trunks and small crowns, and lollipop ball trees. The palm avenue idea itself is right.
Game paves 8 m each side; real has a plain kerb with a 1 m ledge.
Game has a row of coloured beach cabins on the right (good, they exist at Mondello) and the Capo Gallo ridge is the right shape.
Parked cars along the left kerb: missing.
Real left is a white plastered wall with a gate, tropical shrubs over it and parked cars; game has an open bright strip, a lone building and no wall.
Real has a huge Phoenix palm with a full crown and stone pines at the road edge; game has palm trunks with tiny crowns.
Real road is 7 m, with a kerbed sandy verge and a bus stop on the right; game is a 10 m carriageway with a 3 m pale strip, bollards and no bus stop.
Bus stop pole and timetable board missing.

viewpoints.name: Via Principe di Scalea @75%
viewpoints.verdict: Via Principe di Scalea, 3 m, Oct 2019 (backlit).

findings.text: Real right side is a dense tall hedge and tree wall behind a kerb, left side has parked SUVs along a clipped hedge and a villa; game has a lime lawn strip with pedestrians, scattered ball trees and an open pale paved walk.
Real road has a double white centre line and a solid edge line; game has a single dashed line.
Parked cars along the left kerb missing; one floating light-blue box car at left instead.
Villas in the distance are buff boxes; real villas are mostly hidden by greenery.

viewpoints.name: Mondello beach front
viewpoints.verdict: Mondello (pano crop 97 degrees off heading, so the crop may not match the game direction), 4 m, Oct 2019.

findings.text: Real street is a 6 m lane between plaster garden walls and hedges under mature stone pines and eucalyptus, with parked cars and a Liberty villa tower; game is a 10 m road with a broad pale pavement, a lawn, a lone tall palm and a 3 m pothole decal.
Real trees are huge irregular broadleaf and stone pines; game trees are faceted domes of one size.
Row of black hexagon pits plus a 3 m pit in the foreground; real surface is even with one manhole.

viewpoints.name: Viale Galatea @50%
viewpoints.verdict: Viale Galatea (pano crop faces a fence), 3 m, Oct 2019, 25 degrees off.

findings.text: Real roadside is a wooden picket fence on a low wall under a leaning broadleaf tree and thick shrubs; game has pale pavement, bollards and a long flat wall in the distance.
Overgrown understory shrubs missing.

viewpoints.name: Via Piano di Gallo @50%
viewpoints.verdict: Via Piano di Gallo, 7 m, Oct 2019.

findings.text: Game fills the roadside with a grove of fat, 15 m tall palm trunks with spiky crowns; real roadside is stone pine and holm oak woodland with a few palms and agave, and a limestone cliff above.
Real left side is a rubble stone retaining wall topped with an iron fence and a villa garden; game has bollards and paving only.
Real bend has a coach, wheelie bins, a blue ornamental lamp and a hotel building; none present.

Real road runs straight between garden walls and hedges with trees overhead, asphalt to the kerb; game has 12 m wide pale pavements with a tan terrain tongue at the left edge and a big dark rectangle patch on the carriageway.
Garden walls, plaster fences, tree canopy and a parked car row missing.
The Pellegrino-Gallo ridge in the distance is a convincing match and the pine dots on it are a good touch.

viewpoints.name: Via Partanna Mondello @25%
viewpoints.verdict: Via Partanna Mondello, 5 m, Oct 2019 (backlit, camera low).

findings.text: Real road is a 3 lane road with a steel guard rail, tufted agave and ornamental grass at the kerb and a lamp-post line; game has lawn strip, pale paving and bollards.
Commercial frontage (car dealer with signs and fence) and billboards missing; game shows an ashlar-textured blank wall.

viewpoints.name: Via Partanna Mondello @75%
viewpoints.verdict: Mondello (pano crop 93 degrees off), 3 m, Oct 2019.

findings.text: Real lane is hemmed by a rubble wall topped with a diamond mesh fence on the right and a villa on the left under trees; game puts a buff box with a green door right at the camera and a wide pale piazza behind.
Mature trees over the lane missing.
Game pale paved area to the right at the end of the lane; real has houses.
Real right side is villa gardens with a brick or stone wall, gates and cypress; game has a pale paved apron with a red car.
A central reservation with a verge is present in both (good); game strip is tinted sand and weedy lawn, real is a concrete kerbed median with oleander.
Cypress, stone pine and flowering trees lining the road are missing.
Real road has solid white edge lines, hatched shoulder and a steel crash barrier; game has a dashed centre line and an unmarked edge with a sand tint verge.
Real left side is a row of mature ficus and eucalyptus with trunks leaning; game trees are low-poly balls with a single spruce cone.
Backdrop mountain is right in shape (Monte Gallo and Pellegrino ridge), game ridge is smoother and greener.
Real road is a dual carriageway with white edge lines and curved kerbs, hedges and villa walls on the right; game has a single carriageway between two wide sand-and-lawn strips.
Villa walls and hedges at the road edge missing.

viewpoints.name: Via Sferracavallo @30%
viewpoints.verdict: Via Sferracavallo, 6 m, Oct 2019 (against the light).

findings.text: Real right side is a tall stone gate pier with iron gate and a long wall; left has a plaster villa with balcony and Phoenix palm. Game has pale pavements and a huge pale paved lot on the right with bunting blocks.
Parked cars along the left kerb and utility poles with overhead wires missing.
Real houses are 2 to 3 storey whitewashed villas; game left buildings are ochre blocks with coloured bunting squares and blue shutters.

viewpoints.name: Via Pietro Calandra @50%
viewpoints.verdict: Via Pietro Calandra / A29 slip road, 7 m, Apr 2024.

findings.text: Real road at this point is a motorway-grade ramp towards the A19/A20 with steel crash barriers both sides, a green gantry sign (Palermo, Catania, Messina, Tommaso Natale, Mondello, Sferracavallo), a retaining wall with fence and a scrub embankment; game has a 2 lane road, a 4 m puddle decal and a pale paved slope.
The white paved slope on the right replaces a vegetated embankment with a retaining wall and a mesh fence.
A single huge spruce cone stands beside the road; real roadside is broadleaf trees, olive and bare dirt with a billboard and a 2 m rubble-and-concrete wall.
The long wall on the right (about 1.5 m high, ochre plaster) is missing; game has bollards and a pale paved walk.
Real road is wide and fresh with solid edge lines; game has a dashed centre line and dashed edges with a lawn strip median.

viewpoints.name: Via Rosario Nicoletti @80%
viewpoints.verdict: Via Rosario Nicoletti junction, 1 m, Oct 2019 (backlit).

findings.text: Real junction has clean asphalt and a zebra crossing with kerbs; game has sand tint bands and a bare lawn triangle.
Real island has shrubs and olive trees with a hedge; game has grass only.
Real has road signs on gantries, a billboard, parked cars on the right; game has piles of dumpsters.
Real road has a continuous 0.8 m dry-stone parapet on the valley side and a rock cut with grass tufts on the other; game has neither, the road simply ends at a grass slope.
Real slope is dry grass tufts, shrubs and a few Aleppo pines; game has 20 m tall spruce cones and a lime-green slope.
Real road is about 6 m with a continuous white edge line on the left and a centre double line; game is 8 m with a short dashed line, pit decals and no edge line.
The panorama of the bay and Monte Catalfano is good in both.

viewpoints.name: Via Pietro Bonanno @86%
viewpoints.verdict: Via Pietro Bonanno hairpin, 20 m, Sept 2018.

findings.text: Real hairpin runs under an overhanging ochre limestone cliff with rock outcrops and a grassy verge; game has pale grey sawtooth terrain wedges and a sandy cut with a stone texture of dark dots.
Game road narrows to a ledge between spikes; real road is a continuous 6 m carriageway with a 0.5 m verge.
Real has a low dry-stone wall on the left and Ampelodesmos tufts; game has neither.
No scrub or agave in the game; real has agave and tall grass at the foot of the cliff.
Real left side is hedge-covered garden walls with iron gates and villas; game has a wide pale pavement and blank ochre blocks.
Real trees are street broadleaves (nettle tree / pistachio type) with dappled shade; game has ball trees, tall palms with sparse crowns.
Real has a yellow wheelie bin and parked cars; game has a parked car row on the right, which is good.

Real left is a plaster and brick wall with a decorative iron gate, bougainvillea and oleander above and a pine over the road; right side is a stone wall with fence along the sea. Game shows a sand band left and a huge pale paved slope on the right.
The pale paved slope at the foot of the cliff replaces the real rock face with scrub.
Limestone cliff is present in the game and reads convincingly.
Real right side is a tall rubble stone retaining wall with a mesh fence; sea side has a steel crash barrier. Game has a sandy slope with spruce cones.
Real road is cracked 2 lane asphalt with solid edge lines and a shoulder; game has a dashed centre line only.
Real sea side has a barrier and rock shore with a tower in the distance; game hides it behind a bus.

viewpoints.name: Lungomare Cristoforo Colombo @90%
viewpoints.verdict: Lungomare Cristoforo Colombo at a signalised crossing, 7 m, Oct 2019.

findings.text: Real right side is a white stone-clad garden wall topped by a clipped hedge and trees; game has a pale paved slope and bare ground.
Traffic lights on curved mast arms, zebra crossing with long white bars, pedestrian crossing sign missing in the game.
Tall palms in game (good for the lungomare) but real foreground vegetation is dense evergreen hedge and pine; game has a lone spruce.
Cliff face at the right is a good match in shape.

Real lane is 4 to 5 m between an oleander hedge with grass verge (left) and a retaining wall with stairs (right), under tall Aleppo pines, with parked cars; game has an 8 m road, a white paved slab right and spruce cones.
Oleander in flower and Aleppo pine umbrellas missing.
Parked Fiat 500X and a staircase entrance on the right missing.
Road too wide by 3 m and with pit decals; real is worn with patches.
Real right side is a continuous 3 m masonry wall (long, stuccoed) with cypress behind; game has bollards and a pale pavement with garage-fronted blocks.
Cars parked bumper to bumper on both kerbs; game has none.
Real left side has low villas and a domed building, game has two plain 3 storey blocks.
Same long tall wall and plane trees in the real photo; game shows sand bands, a pale pavement and an open dry field at the right.
Row of parked cars on both kerbs missing; dumpsters double-parked in game.

viewpoints.name: Via Papa Sergio I @50%
viewpoints.verdict: Via Papa Sergio I, 1 m, Oct 2019.

findings.text: Real right side is a 3 m ashlar stone wall with oleander and cypress behind, left has plaster walls and plane trees; game has a pale pavement and a shed with bunting.
Mature street trees and oleander missing.
Game road has a big pothole and sand-tinged edge; real asphalt is clean with a kerb and an edge ledge.

viewpoints.name: Via Papa Sergio Primo @50%
viewpoints.verdict: Via Papa Sergio Primo, 2 m, Oct 2019.

findings.text: Real street has cars parked along both kerbs, nose to tail; game has two dumpsters and an empty pavement.
Real right palazzina sits behind a wrought-iron fence on a stone plinth; game blocks stand directly on the pavement.
Real buildings are yellow and ochre plaster with arched windows, deep balconies and green shutters; game are tan blocks with blue shutters and bunting on every storey.
Heights and street width are close to the real street.

viewpoints.name: Nostra Donna del Rotolo @50%
viewpoints.verdict: Via Nostra Donna del Rotolo, 37 m, Oct 2019.

findings.text: Real street frames the grey limestone wall of Monte Pellegrino at the end of the street; game vista is closed by buildings with no cliff backdrop.
Real right side is a low stone wall with a mesh fence and a reed thicket; left has fences and garden hedges. Game has blank walls with roller shutters right on the pavement.
Real road is 9 to 10 m with kerbside parking and bins; game street is 5 m with a raised pavement on each side.
Real avenue is a tunnel of mature broadleaf oaks and poplars with dry grass and orchard trees behind; game has lime lawn with spruce cones and an empty horizon.
Real road has a solid white edge line on the left and a yellow one on the right, game has a pale kerb stripe only.
Real road has a Fiat Panda ahead, game has a white van (ok).

viewpoints.name: Viale Leonardo da Vinci @20%
viewpoints.verdict: Viale Leonardo da Vinci, 7 m, Mar 2019.

findings.text: Real avenue has a tram line behind a black iron railing with red overhead-wire poles, tram stop shelter, kerbside parking along the right and 12 storey balcony towers; game has an unmarked 4 lane road, a pale pavement on the left and ochre mid-rise.
Pit decals 2 to 3 m wide on a road that is smooth in reality.

viewpoints.name: Viale Leonardo da Vinci @50%
viewpoints.verdict: Viale Leonardo da Vinci, 7 m, Mar 2019.

findings.text: Real median carries a decorative black iron railing, a tram or trolley wire mast line and lamps; game has a bare edge.
Real left and right have tall leafless plane trees and a fruit stand under an awning; game has lime lawn and sparse ball trees.
Real avenue is lined by continuous 8 to 10 storey apartment blocks (left); game has open ground with distant blocks.
Monte Grifone backdrop is accurate in shape.

viewpoints.name: Viale Leonardo da Vinci @80%
viewpoints.verdict: Viale Leonardo da Vinci, 2 m, Mar 2019.

findings.text: Real central reservation carries a tram line with red overhead poles, a black iron railing, and a continuous parked-car row; game has an unmarked carriageway with a pale pavement.
Real left and right sides are 10 to 14 storey balcony towers in white, orange and brown; game has fewer, lower, ochre blocks and low sheds.
Monte Grifone peak at the end of the avenue is clearly visible in both; the game one is a good match.
Real avenue has a double row of mature plane trees on both sides and a hedge strip; game has none.
Parked cars along the right kerb missing; real balconied blocks have continuous balcony fronts.
Pit decals are 2 to 3 m wide; real surface is smooth with a small drain.
Game has 6 to 8 m pale pavement either side; real has kerb and 2 m pavements.
Real roadside has plane trees, a stone pine and a palm; game has bare sand and tan paving.
Real right has a concrete panel wall with a gate; game has an open pale paved apron.
Game road sits on a 10 to 15 m wide tan band and blank pale apron; real asphalt runs straight to a kerb.

Real is a 3 lane motorway-grade carriageway with continuous steel guard rails, solid white edge lines, tall lamp masts and a row of billboards; game has 2 lanes on a sand-coloured band with pits up to 3 m wide.
Mountain backdrop (Monte Billiemi / Pizzo Cane side) is close in shape but too smooth and pale green.

Real is a 3 lane carriageway with solid edge lines, steel guard rails both sides, tufted scrub verges, motorway-style lamps, speed limit signs and a billboard; game has a median lawn (good) but a 2 lane road with a faint dash, no guard rail, no signs. Confirms survey finding 5.
Verges are agave-like tufts and brush; game has lime lawn and spruce cones.
Real is a curving expressway ramp with a guard rail, grass verge, a big stone pine and heavy truck traffic; game has a straight 2 lane road with a pale pavement on the right and no verge.
Stone pine canopy and roadside shrubs missing; game has none in view.
Real left tower block (8 storey, cream) appears in the distance; game has similar blocks but ochre.

Real road is a 3 lane carriageway with a concrete retaining wall and railings on the right and tall blocks on the left; game puts the camera on a bare sand plain with no road mesh under it (road-hidden-by-terrain, known issue from the survey).
The tram viaduct wall and guard rail are absent.

Real central reservation carries a tram line with red overhead-wire poles, iron railings and signalled crossings; game has a wide sand-coloured median and a zebra crossing. The tram is a strong city identifier.
Real near block is plain salmon plaster 5 storey; game blocks are tan with balcony strips (ok in massing).
Real street is packed with cars parked double-deep on both sides, shop awnings and a tabacchi sign; game has an empty 4 lane road with pale pavements.
Real left side has a dense wall of evergreen trees; game has a bare median strip.
Right block of 8 storeys is a good height match; real facade is pale cream with long balconies, game is tan.

Real left side is a tram line with iron fence and red poles; right has a white noise barrier on a concrete wall, a big ficus overhanging the road and a cracked pavement. Game has a wide sand band and a 4 m puddle decal.
Giant ficus canopy over the road is missing.
Monte Billiemi silhouette in the real photo is steeper and darker.

Real lane runs between iron-railed walls and a green mesh fence with a stone-and-concrete gate pier, under eucalyptus and holm oak; game is a flat road across a bare ochre plain with a row of parked cars on the horizon.
Eucalyptus avenue and shrubs missing.
Real road has fenced gardens and villas on both sides; game has empty ground (missing buildings and land use).
Real street has cars parked bumper to bumper on both kerbs; game has none.
Real has a broadleaf tree over the right kerb and balcony plants; game has no trees.
Real facades are cream and brown plaster with wrought-iron balcony railings and awnings; game blocks have bunting and teal balconies.

Real right side is a 3 m precast concrete wall with a rusty spiked fence on top, left is a scrub embankment with broom and shrubs. Game has the embankment (good) but a pale paved strip and a tall lamp pole instead of the wall.
Scrub and broom on the embankment is missing: grass only.
Pit decals are 2 m wide; real surface is smooth with a rumble strip.

viewpoints.name: Via Oreto @20%
viewpoints.verdict: Via Oreto, 5 m, Apr 2021; photo is motion-blurred and 31 degrees off heading.

findings.text: Real street is a busy shopping street with parked scooters, cars both sides and shop signs in red and yellow; game is a quiet canyon of two ochre slabs.
Real facades have deep balconies, awnings and shop fronts; game blocks are windowless ochre slabs.

Real junction is a busy street with market stalls under white awnings, 5 to 8 storey blocks on both sides and a flyover rail; game has a tan open plain with scattered blocks and dumpsters. Confirms the Via Oreto empty-plain finding.
Game has a large sand band left of the road and a dark rectangular patch right; real has kerbs and pavements.
Billboards, lamp posts with double arms, market stalls and heavy traffic missing.
Real central reservation has a tram line with red overhead poles and decorative iron railings, signalled crossing; game has a sand patch on the left and a pale pavement on the right.
Real right-hand buildings are 19th century palazzi with iron balconies, shutters and a palm on a terrace; game shows plain ochre blocks with ribbed fronts.
Overall street width and block height are close.

viewpoints.name: Corso dei Mille @50%
viewpoints.verdict: Corso dei Mille side, 6 m, Mar 2021, 16 degrees off.

findings.text: Cars parked along both kerbs, shop awnings and a person at the kerb; game has none, only an empty road.
Real palazzine are terracotta-coloured with wrought iron balconies and flowerpots; game has similar colour but a monotone arcade of identical shopfronts at street level.
Real road surface is patched and rough; game is smoother with decals (closer than most).

viewpoints.name: Corso dei Mille @85%
viewpoints.verdict: Corso dei Mille side street, 4 m, Mar 2021.

findings.text: Real street has cars parked on both kerbs, a dumpster, shop shutters and laundry hung on balconies; game has none of these.
Real facades have deep balconies, awnings and varied plaster; game blocks are plain 3 storey boxes with identical windows.
A flat tan rectangle lies across the carriageway in the game (terrain tint showing through the road).

viewpoints.name: Viale Regione Siciliana Sud Est @15%
viewpoints.verdict: Viale Regione Siciliana Sud Est, 5 m, Mar 2021.

findings.text: Real roadside has an IP petrol station with canopy and price sign, billboards and arching lamp posts, a steel guard rail and a stone pine; game has a lawn strip, one palm and an office block.
Stone pine umbrellas and roadside scrub missing; game has one fat palm and ball trees.
Game sand band left and pale apron right; real has dirt shoulder with litter and a guard rail (so dirt IS present, but with a rail and kerb).

viewpoints.name: Viale Regione Siciliana Sud Est @40%
viewpoints.verdict: SS113 / Viale Regione Siciliana Sud Est, 5 m, Apr 2026.

findings.text: Real road runs under a continuous tunnel of stone pines (umbrella crowns, 15 m) next to a steel guard rail; game has two sand bands and bare ground with tower blocks.
Guard rail, kerbs and edge lines missing; the road is a 3 lane carriageway in reality.
Mountain backdrop is a fair match.

viewpoints.name: Viale Regione Siciliana Sud Est @65%
viewpoints.verdict: Viale Regione Siciliana Sud Est (pano), 15 m, Sept 2026 (newest photo of all).

findings.text: Real road has a long row of stone pines and palms on a planted median with a steel guard rail and billboards; game has sand bands and a black car.
Median with guard rail and lamp posts missing; game has a flat single carriageway.

viewpoints.name: Viale Regione Siciliana Sud Est @90%
viewpoints.verdict: Viale Regione Siciliana Sud Est (elevated section), 6 m, Apr 2026.

findings.text: Real is a raised expressway with double steel guard rails, mesh fence and tall twin-arm lamps next to a rock cut; game has a 2 lane road with sand verge and a white paved slope.
Retaining cut with mesh fence missing, replaced by a pale paving slope.
Real street has cars parked nose to tail on both kerbs and a central strip with shrubs; game has a floating white car and a sand verge.
Brown 12 storey balconied tower on the right and the mountain backdrop match well; real balconies have plants and awnings.
Game has sand-coloured bands and a wide pale pavement.

viewpoints.name: Via Pio La Torre @50%
viewpoints.verdict: Via Pio La Torre, 6 m, Feb 2018.

findings.text: Real side street has cars parked along both kerbs and graffiti-covered wheelie bins; game has one car, one dumpster and a bare sand verge.
Mature street trees (planes and ficus) on the left missing.
Real 12 storey slab with coloured balcony strips is a landmark of this district; game blocks are 5 to 6 storey ochre.
Real avenue has a long row of pollarded plane trees on both kerbs; game has none.
Real kerb has a bank of wheelie bins, a large billboard and a petrol station; game has a white car and a bare pale apron with a tan band.
Game has an 8 m tan band on the left and a rectangular dark patch on the road.
Real junction is clean asphalt with kerbs and recycling bins; game has a tan terrain plain with big pit decals where the road should be.
Row of yellow recycling bins, stone pine, oleander and signs missing.
Real orange-ochre blocks with balcony columns are a good colour match to the game's ochre.
Real lane runs beside a 2 m concrete wall with a plaque, reeds, stone pines and cypresses; game has a huge pale slab plaza and tall blocks.
Reeds, pines and cypress missing.
Game has 20 m of pale paving beside a 6 m road; real is a lane with a walled edge.
Real street is an avenue of broadleaf trees with a canopy over the road and recycling bins; game is an empty sand and paving plain with distant blocks.
Cars parked on both kerbs and bins missing; game has a white box car and sparse traffic.
Real street is enclosed by houses and walls; game has open ground.

Real lane is a 3.5 m strip between a whitewashed rubble wall (left) and a dry-stone terrace wall topped with hedge and olive trees (right), under a rock massif; game has a wide strip across bare ochre ground.
Real mountain is a steep grey limestone face with green scrub terraces; game slope is a smooth beige mound with a few pines.
Olive trees, hedges and terraces missing.

Real junction is a rural village edge with 1 to 2 storey houses behind rubble and plaster walls, a Norfolk pine and the limestone ridge beyond; game has 6 storey apartment blocks with shutters and bunting and an urban canyon.
Whitewashed and rubble garden walls, an iron gate and road signs missing.

viewpoints.name: Salvatore Corleone @50%
viewpoints.verdict: Via Salvatore Corleone roundabout, 1 m, Sept 2018.

findings.text: Real is a landscaped roundabout with kerbed island, shrubs, give-way and roundabout signs, a long line of lamp posts and a pylon; game is a flat tan plain with a 2 lane road, tricycle taxis and dumpsters.
Real horizon has a fenced industrial yard, tank, and a railway embankment with overhead wires; game has distant low blocks only. Confirms the tan-plain finding for Salvatore Corleone.

viewpoints.name: Filippo Pecoraino @50%
viewpoints.verdict: Via Filippo Pecoraino roundabout, 3 m, Mar 2021.

findings.text: Real roundabout island has date palms and a pine grove; game has a grass island with ball trees and a spruce, closer than average.
Real has a lorry, a kerb with a drainage channel and traffic signs; game has a dumpster on the island.

viewpoints.name: Giovanni Di Stefano @50%
viewpoints.verdict: Via Giovanni Di Stefano, 5 m, Feb 2018.

findings.text: Real is an elevated viaduct with concrete parapet, lamp posts and trucks; game is a road across a flat tan plain with no parapet. The elevated section is missing.
Real horizon has industrial chimneys and a port skyline.
Real lane is hemmed by a 4 m rough ashlar wall on the right with weeds and a plastered farmhouse with tiled eaves on the left; game has two flat-roofed boxes with garage shutters and pale pavements.
Real terracotta plaster with a pitched tile roof and arch doorway; game boxes have flat roofs and cartoon brick patches.
Real lane is 4 m and smooth; game is 7 m with pit decals.
Real houses are low yellow and ochre villini with balcony railings and parked cars in a village street; game has a 5 storey block with bunting and a 4 m pothole.
The 4 m wide pit decal in the foreground is out of scale with the road.
Real lane has 2 m plastered garden walls with gates and a row of parked cars under trees; game has a wide road, a pale paved square with a bus stop and three bunting blocks.
Mature trees missing.
Real left side is a long rubble stone wall with a wrought-iron fence and a stone pine; game has a pale plaza with a dull block. Walls and garden missing.
Parked cars, a pine and utility wires missing.

viewpoints.name: Via Papa Giovanni Paolo II @50%
viewpoints.verdict: Via Papa Giovanni Paolo II, 3 m, Mar 2021.

findings.text: Real left side is a 2 m orange works hoarding and a wall with an iron gate; right has cars parked at the kerb; game has a lawn and a pale pavement.
Game has bright lime lawn on the right, real has none.

viewpoints.name: Via Messina Marine @20%
viewpoints.verdict: Via Messina Marine, 3 m, Sept 2018 (good structural match).

findings.text: Real street has dumpsters overflowing at the kerb, double-parked cars and shop signs; game is clean with a white van and a bare pavement.
Real has big date palms on the right; game has a lamp post and nothing planted.
Game shows the sea at the end of the road on the right, which real hides behind buildings, but the sea-side layout is plausible.
Real fronts are pink and ochre with deep balconies and a modern cafe sign; game has a tan block with orange awnings.
Real street has cars on both kerbs, a stepped brick pavement and balcony plants; game has an unbroken tan pavement and two empty facades.
Real left blocks are ochre villini with decorated balconies and a yellow tower; game has two 4 storey long slabs with a repeated window grid.
Game pavement is a 10 m pale apron.
Real road runs between a ruined ashlar farmhouse wall (right) and a guard rail with dense Mediterranean trees (left); game is a flat road through a tan plain with a lone dumpster.
Real tall rough-cut stone ruin and tree canopy missing; confirms the south coast plain finding.
The game shows the sea at the right horizon, which real hides behind vegetation.
Real roadside has eucalyptus, birches and bamboo; game has bare ochre ground with sparse traffic.
Real road is rough asphalt with a kerb and a roundabout apron; game has a dashed line and a 4 m puddle.
Real seafront has tall Washingtonia and Phoenix palms and big clipped pittosporum hedges; game has faceted ball trees on tan dirt bands and no palms.
Foro Italico is an ordinary 3 lane road with kerbs, bollards and a low wall in the real photo; game road is 8 m on a 20 m tan dirt strip. No sea wall or balustrade in view.
Real view shows Monte Pellegrino and the Porta Felice side building at the end of the road; game shows only a flat green and a pale sheet.
Real road is full of traffic, scooters and street lamps in curved arms; game road is empty.

viewpoints.name: Foro Italico @30%
viewpoints.verdict: Foro Italico towards the Porta dei Greci, 17 m, May 2021.

findings.text: Real view ends at a neoclassical colonnaded gateway with a lion-topped pediment (Porta dei Greci) behind palms; game shows a plain arcaded block among ball trees (gate being worked on by another agent).
Washingtonia palm and clipped oleander hedges at the left in the real photo; game has one fat palm and broad ball trees.
Row of parked cars along the right kerb missing; real road has a worn surface and pedestrian crossing signs.
Date palms in groups, shrubs and a stand of pines are replaced by spruce cones and ball trees.
Game road sits on 15 m sand bands left and right; real road has a kerb and pavement with a stall and signs.
Real roadside has a barbecue stall, parked cars, parking sign and lamp posts; game has dumpsters.
Real left has a fence with orange netting (works) and tall Washingtonia palms plus a stone balustrade on the right; game has ball trees and spruce cones on tan ground.
No balustrade or sea wall in the game; the real right side has a stone balustrade with posts.
Zebra stripes and skid pairs are drawn wrongly (white blocks read as a smudged word, black skid pair crossing the whole lane).
Real crossing has 8 wide stripes and the street has yellow hatching; game stripes are broken and half-missing, with skid pairs and a long black rectangle.
Real left palms and a bare plane tree; the game has a few palms in the distance but fat ball trees in the foreground.
Real right side is a white painted wall with a railing (garden wall of an old villa); game shows a lawn and an ochre office block.
Game has a 10 m pale paved apron on the left with a tall lamp pole and tan bands on the right; real has a kerb with a flower bed, parked cars and a pavement.
Real has umbrella stone pines and clipped shrubs; game has none.
Roadworks sign, parked cars missing.
Real street has a works hoarding of orange mesh and portable toilet, a billboard, parked cars; game is tidy.
Palm garden on the right is replaced by lawn with ball trees.
Real left block is 7 storey cream with balconies; game block is 6 storey tan with arched shopfronts (massing ok).
Real road is lined by palms and a row of traffic lights, with a bike lane marking; game has a few palms but mostly ball trees.
Game has 6 m of pale paving left and a 7 m grey pavement right, real has a bike lane with white edge lines and parked cars.
Parked cars on both sides missing; scaffolded corner building on the right is missing.

viewpoints.name: Porto, Via Francesco Crispi waterfront
viewpoints.verdict: Port waterfront near Via Crispi, 31 m, Apr 2024.

findings.text: Real area is a brick-paved esplanade with a grass strip, bollard lamps, a palm and a car park; game has pale slab paving and a bare strip.
Real has parked scooters, bins, slim post lamps with cameras; game has SUCA wall tags on a warehouse (SUCA tags being worked on).
Mountain backdrop (Monte Pellegrino with the sanctuary) appears in both.
Real street is shaded by big plane and ficus trees with a row of cars parked along the blue-lined kerb; game has a yellow bus (good local detail) and spruce cones.
Parked cars and bay lines missing, a yellow bus fills the foreground.
Balconied residential blocks 8 to 10 storey match well.
Game puts the camera on a 20 m wide pale plaza with a thin asphalt strip, where the real street has kerbs, blue bays and cars both sides.
Big ficus overhanging the right kerb missing.
Cars parked on both sides missing.

viewpoints.name: Domenico Costantino @50%
viewpoints.verdict: Via Domenico Costantino area, 14 m, June 2014.

findings.text: Real street is shaded by a huge ficus canopy overhanging a stone garden wall; game has no trees and a lawn at the end.
Cars are parked on both kerbs in the real street, with blue bay lines; game has an empty road.
Game has 5 m pale pavements either side; real has 1.5 m pavement strips and parked cars against the kerb.
Real palazzine are pale pink and cream with iron balconies and flower pots and 4 storeys; game has 6 storey tan slabs with continuous balcony ledges and dark shopfronts.

viewpoints.name: Piazza Tredici Vittime
viewpoints.verdict: Piazza Tredici Vittime, 42 m, May 2021; photo is taken in an underpass below a curved viaduct.

findings.text: Real roadway dips under a concrete flyover with retaining walls and a bike barrier; the game has a flat grass park with spruce cones and a single palm at the same spot. The viaduct and cutting are absent.
Lime lawn with spruce cones; the real square has paved ground and few trees.

viewpoints.name: Via Emerico Amari to the sea
viewpoints.verdict: Via Emerico Amari towards the sea, 43 m, Feb 2018.

findings.text: Real left side has a long iron fence with weeds and a 5 storey old palazzo with arched windows in worn cream; game has an empty lawn, a 2 storey brick building and a small hut with a SUCA/800A tag (tags being worked on).
Game shows a pale paved piazza and a thin asphalt strip; real is a 3 lane road with kerbs.
Billboard, lamps, parked cars missing.

viewpoints.name: Porta Felice and Cassaro end
viewpoints.verdict: Foro Italico end near Porta Felice, 36 m, May 2021.

findings.text: Real has tall Washingtonia palms, flowering oleander and a big ficus along a parking-lined seafront road; game has a stone piazza with a lawn and ball trees.
Rows of cars parked along the right kerb and traffic signs missing; game has an esplanade with ornate post lamps (good) but nothing at the kerb.
Porta Felice gate at the far end of the real road is not in view in the game (gates being worked on by another agent).
Curved palazzo block on the right in the game is plausible (Cassaro end).

Real left building is a 1950s concrete block with a deep pilotis arcade, shuttered balconies and shops (a tabacchi, a gold buyer); game shows a baroque-style palazzo with iron balconies and roller shutters.
Real road runs beside a guard-railed cutting with roadworks and cars parked in a tight line; game road is wide with pit decals and a pale pavement.
Real left side has two big broadleaf street trees and bare planes; game has none near the road.
Real street has parked cars both sides, a petrol station at the junction, a long zebra crossing; game has one white box car, one dumpster and a lozenge decal.
Palazzi on both sides are 5 to 6 storey in reality with deep iron balconies; game heights and street width are close.

viewpoints.name: Via Tiro a Segno
viewpoints.verdict: Via Tiro a Segno, 41 m, Aug 2021; the photo stands inside a garden under pines and an ivy-covered viaduct wall, the game stands on a street, not comparable.

findings.text: Real garden has stone pines, tamarisk and ivy; game street has a lawn strip with no trees.

viewpoints.name: Stadio Renzo Barbera, Viale del Fante
viewpoints.verdict: Stadio Renzo Barbera, Viale del Fante, 12 m, Apr 2017; the photo looks away from the stadium.

findings.text: Real roadside is a plaster park wall with flowering Judas trees and stone pines; game has a lawn with spruce cones.
Real junction has traffic lights on a yellow mast arm, a bus lane and zebra stripes; game has skid-mark pairs across the lanes and a stripe band.
